summary: Celebrate berry season at Rosoberry Harvest Fest with pick-your-own berries, live music, delicious local food, wine, craft beer, coffee, ice cream and family fun. description: Celebrate berry season at Rosoberry Harvest Fest with pick-your-own berries, live music, delicious local food, wine, craft beer, coffee, ice cream and family fun. Hosted by Rosoberry Nursery on Hermanus River Farm, this relaxed summer festival celebrates peak berry season, with strawberries, blackberries, youngberries, blueberries, raspberries and pepinos to enjoy straight from the bushes. Your ticket includes a punnet to take home, plus an empty punnet for picking and tasting berries throughout the day. Discover local vendors serving grass-fed beef boeries, brisket bowls, poke bowls, Belgian ales and local wines. Enjoy tractor rides, face painting, lawn games, nursery plants and fresh farm produce, or take a scenic 2.5km walk to the waterfall. Bring a picnic blanket and enjoy a summer day on the farm!

title: Alan Committie: AV-A-LAUGH-TA
summary: It’s been a year, right? If you, like me, could really do with some belly laughs to slide into 2027 on the right foot, look no further than Alan Committie’s brand-new show, which goes curtains-up at Road House Cinema in Whale Coast Mall.
description:
It’s been a year, right?
If you, like me, could really do with some belly laughs to slide into 2027 on the right foot, look no further than Alan Committie’s brand-new show, which goes curtains-up at Road House Cinema in Whale Coast Mall.
Alan Committie is blasting into the festive season with A-VA-LAUGH-TA. True to form, audiences can expect a high-energy, stand-up special designed to banish the blues with interstellar wordplay, physical comedy, and Committie’s trademark take-downs of the crowd, as this award-winning comic tries to make sense of a year where everything feels a bit… alien.
